name: Warriors.UnsafeImpl
description: Lets you use the System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe class methods for your mods (method bodies implemented in IL with Mono.Cecil). You need to reference System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.dll and add a BepInDependency attribute to your plugin class (the ID is: lb-fgf-m4r-ik.warriors.unsafeimpl).
